    counts = Counter(cell for row in grid for cell in row)
    
    # Most frequent is background, second most is foreground  
    sorted_items = sorted(counts.items(), key=lambda x: x[1], reverse=True)
    fg_color = sorted_items[0][0]
    bg_color = sorted_items[1][0]
    target = 2
    
    # Create working copy
    res = [row[:] for row in grid]
    
    # Step 1: Horizontal fill - fill bg between fg in same row (in the ORIGINAL grid)
    for r in range(R):
        fg_indices = [c for c in range(C) if grid[r][c] == fg_color]
        for i in range(len(fg_indices) - 1):
            start, end = fg_indices[i], fg_indices[i+1]
            for c in range(start + 1, end):
                if grid[r][c] == bg_color:
                    res[r][c] = target
    
    # Step 2: Vertical fill - fill IF cell is still bg_color (i.e. was original bg and changed by horiz fill)

            for r in range(start + 1, end):

    items = sorted(counts.items(), key=lambda x: x[1], reverse=True)
    bg = items[1][0]
    fg = items[0][0]
    target = 2
    
    res = [row[:] for row in grid]
    
    # Step 1: Horizontal fill - fill bg cells with target between fg in same row (based on ORIGINAL grid)
    for r in range(R):
        fg_indices = [c for c in range(C) if grid[r][c] == fg]
        for i in range(len(fg_indices) - 1):
            for c in range(fg_indices[i]+1, fg_indices[i+1]):
                res[r][c] = target
    
    # Step 2: Vertical fill - fill CURRENT bg cells with target between fg in same column (check ORIGINAL grid for fg)
    for c in range(C):
        fg_indices = [r for r in range(R) if grid[r][c] == fg]
        for i in range(len(fg_indices) - 1):
            for r in range(fg_indices[i]+1, fg_indices[i+1]):
                res[r][c] = target
    
    return res
